en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city street lined with late‑19th‑century buildings. In the foreground to the left stands a fenced Gothic‑revival stone monument or column with statues in niches and a crenellated top, set in a small landscaped island. Leafless trees frame the scene, and the street extends into the distance with a few pedestrians and early 20th‑century automobiles. On the roofline of a central building in the background there is a large painted advertisement sign.
